posts.zh:
dsh-trilium 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-37605aa2e6718ead9307.html
posts.en:
dsh-trilium is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-37605aa2e6718ead9307.html
